    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AoeUnit
    Abstract base class for units that attack all enemies in range simultaneously (area-of-effect / AoE).
    Attackable
    Defines the contract for any entity that can participate in combat — receiving damage, dealing damage to targets, and reporting its death state.
    BattleManager
    Singleton that owns all living units on the battlefield and provides target-lookup queries used by unit AI every frame.
    BattleManagerTest
     
    BattleManagerTest.StubUnit
    Minimal Unit stub — no JavaFX image loading, suitable for all BattleManager tests.
    CannonButton
    A special-ability button for the player's cannon attack.
    CannonWave
    A sweeping cannon-wave projectile fired from the player's tower.
    Cat1
    The basic player cat unit — cheap, fast cooldown, and single-target.
    CatButton
    An interactive unit-deploy button used in the in-game HUD.
    CatTower
    The player's home base tower, positioned at the right side of the battlefield.
    China
    Stage 3 — China.
    Dog1
    The basic enemy dog unit — low HP, light damage, single-target.
    DogTower
    The enemy home base tower, positioned at the left side of the battlefield.
    EffectManager
    Singleton that manages all active visual effects on the battlefield.
    ExplosionEffect
    A short five-frame explosion visual effect anchored to a world position.
    FishCat
    A tanky single-target cat unit with long range and high damage.
    GameStage
    Abstract base class for all game stages (levels).
    Hippo
    A heavy single-target enemy — massive HP, high damage, slow attack and movement.
    Japan
    Stage 2 — Japan.
    KnightCat
    A fast single-target cat unit with moderate HP and range.
    Korea
    Stage 1 — Korea.
    LevelUpButton
    A wallet-upgrade button displayed in the in-game HUD.
    Main
    Main application class and top-level controller for Battle Cat - Complete Edition.
    MoneyManager
    Singleton that manages the player's money throughout a stage.
    MoneyManagerTest
     
    Moveable
    Defines the contract for any entity that can move along the battlefield.
    Pig
    A powerful AoE enemy unit — very high HP, high damage, but slow.
    SingleTargetUnit
    Abstract base class for units that attack one enemy at a time.
    Snake
    A fast single-target enemy with medium HP.
    Stickman
    A fast single-target enemy with low HP but high damage — a glass-cannon threat.
    Thailand
    Stage 5 — Thailand (final stage).
    TofuCat
    A wide AoE cat unit shaped like a tofu block — slow but hits everything directly in front of it.
    Tower
    Represents an immovable base structure (tower) for either side.
    TowerBurstEffect
    A five-frame burst visual effect played at the moment a tower is destroyed.
    TowerTest
    Tests for Tower — a concrete Unit subclass with no attack/movement.
    UFOCat
    An AoE cat unit that fires a three-wave rolling explosion attack.
    Unit
    Abstract base class for every entity on the battlefield — cats, dogs, and towers alike.
    Unit.State
    Animation state machine used to select the correct sprite sheet row and drive movement/death behaviour.
    UnitTest
    Tests for Unit base class logic — no JavaFX rendering involved.
    UnitTest.ConcreteUnit
